caption: Rocca Costanza, Pesaro
composition: Brick Renaissance fortress bastions by the Adriatic · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the road the camera faces the corner bastion of the Rocca Costanza, its massive brick walls running left and the keep rising at the corner. An umbrella pine stands at the far left, while the Adriatic opens on the right with a distant headland. The 08:46 morning light warms the brick.
